newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares fall from heady days of record highs.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares fall from heady days of record highs.

text.p: Egypt share prices continued to retreat on Thursday as the stock market corrected itself from the rarefied highs it had reached in previous weeks.
The all-share index fell 10.4 points to 404.35 in a volume of 84.70 million pounds ($24.9 million), the Capital Market Authority (CMA) said in its daily report.
"It was expected to happen for quite a while. It's healthy to see a correction," said Neveen al-Tahry, of Delta EAB. "Many people are alarmed about the decrease but it's only normal.
"Most of us have not given 'buy' recommendation as the market was on the upswing," she said.
The index had in previous weeks hit record levels, climaxing at 427.77 points on Monday but brokers said it was slipping due to profit taking and as a result of a natural correction.
Most of the day's most heavily traded shares fell.
PACHIN/Paints and Chemical Industries dominated trade on Thursday for the third day with more than 15.84 million pounds but the share slipped 2.0 pounds to close at 154.9, the CMAsaid.
Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid had said that the state would offer another share tranche to anchor investors.
Amriyah Cement was the day's second most active share with 8.4 million pounds changing hands. Its share fell 3.25 pounds to 82.75.
Abu Qir Fertilisers and Chemical Industries also put in a good showing with 6.16 million pounds in volume. Its share price slid 5.84 pounds to close at 111.06.
Commercial International Bank (CIB) slipped 46.1 pounds to close at 875.43 with more than 4.9 million pounds changing hands.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 685.53 points from 712.11 points on Wednesday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms also fell, closing at 263.47 from 267.83.
Out of the 98 shares traded, 24 gained, 47 lost and 27 ended the day unchanged.
